title: M-PAM Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate M -PAM-modulated data, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type Inherit via internal; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Output type}, {Constellation ordering} sets the mapping order, {Normalization method} sets the scaling method for the constellation Min. distance between, {Minimum distance} sets the distance between two nearest constellation, {Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)}, {Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the maximum power, {Denormalization factor}, {Product output}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the option to saturate on integer overflow and {Sum}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: Mapping order of symbols Binary (default) | Gray

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scaling method for the constellation Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: Distance between two nearest constellation points 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Denormalization factor
params.values: Denormalization factor data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Wrap (default) | Saturate

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Option to saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Sum
params.values: Sum data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16) |
